pinyin: yǒu yī tiān zhè huì ràng nǐ yí hàn de.
english: You will be sorry for it some day.

pinyin: bié gēn wǒ shuō nǐ bù zhī dào.
english: Don't tell me you didn't know.

chinese: 我会尽快给你打电话的。
pinyin: wǒ huì jǐn kuài gěi nǐ dǎ diàn huà de.
english: I'll call you as soon as I can.

pinyin: kàn wǒ wèi nǐ zuò le shén me.
english: Look what I made for you.

chinese: 我去年以來就沒再做了。
pinyin: wǒ qù nián yǐ lái jiù méi zài zuò le.
english: I haven't done that since last year.

chinese: 怎么了？你看上去不太开心。
pinyin: zěn me le? nǐ kàn shang qu bù tài kāi xīn.
english: What's wrong? You don't look too happy.

pinyin: hǎo de bù xiàng shì zhēn de.
english: Too good to be true.

pinyin: tā yī zhí kàn wǒ zuò de shì.
english: He always looks at what I'm doing.

pinyin: tā de gǎn mào yī dìng shì hǎo le.
english: He must have gotten over his cold.

pinyin: nǐ chōu yān duō jiǔ le?
english: How long have you been smoking?

chinese: 这里面我有很多不懂的。
pinyin: zhè lǐ miàn wǒ yǒu hěn duō bù dǒng de.
english: I don't understand much about it.

pinyin: wǒ bù zài jiù bié kāi shǐ.
english: Don't begin without me.

pinyin: nǐ de chuáng yǒu duō dà ya?
english: How big is your bed?

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng chī píng guǒ pài.
english: I want to eat apple pie.

chinese: 我很抱歉伤害了你的感情。
pinyin: wǒ hěn bào qiàn shāng hài le nǐ de gǎn qíng.
english: I'm so sorry I hurt your feelings.

pinyin: nǐ kàn qǐ lai shén me dōu zhī dào.
english: You seem to know everything.

pinyin: nǐ néng zhǔn shí zuò hǎo ma?
english: Can you make it on time?

chinese: 我来问个有点傻的问题。
pinyin: wǒ lái wèn ge yǒu diǎn shǎ de wèn tí.
english: Let me ask a stupid question.

pinyin: wǒ bù xiǎng ràng nǐ shāng hài.
english: I don't want to hurt you.

pinyin: kòng zhì zhù zì jǐ!
english: Control yourself!

chinese: 你觉得我明天约会穿什么好呢？
pinyin: nǐ jué de wǒ míng tiān yuē huì chuān shén me hǎo ne?
english: What do you think I should wear on my date tomorrow?

pinyin: wǒ de yìng pán kuài mǎn le.
english: My hard drive is almost full.

chinese: 我想把阅读灯关了，行吗？
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng bǎ yuè dú dēng guān le, xíng ma?
english: I'd like to turn off the reading lamp, is that OK?

chinese: 今天的报纸我还没有看。
pinyin: jīn tiān de bào zhǐ wǒ hái méi yǒu kàn.
english: I've not read today's paper yet.

chinese: 你看起來好像餓了似的。
pinyin: nǐ kàn qǐ lai hǎo xiàng è le shì de.
english: You look like you're hungry.

pinyin: shéi shī nǐ zuì xǐ huan de lǎo shī?
english: Who's your favorite teacher?

pinyin: nǐ wèi guo mǎ le ma?
english: Have you already fed the horses?

pinyin: chú fēi wǒ sǐ le!
english: Over my dead body.

chinese: 有了坚定的目标，你会做得很好。
pinyin: yǒu le jiān dìng de mù biāo, nǐ huì zuò de hěn hǎo.
english: With a firm goal in mind, you will do well.

pinyin: xiǎo huǒ zi, zài zhè r gàn má ne?
english: What are you doing here, young man?

chinese: 有什么东西是我不该吃的吗?
pinyin: yǒu shén me dōng xi shì wǒ bù gāi chī de ma?
english: Is there anything that I shouldn't eat?

pinyin: xiè xie nǐ de dá fù.
english: Thanks for your reply.

chinese: 这个娃娃是你自己做的吗？
pinyin: zhè ge wá wa shì nǐ zì jǐ zuò de ma?
english: Did you make this doll by yourself?

chinese: 你不应该在学校大楼里奔跑。
pinyin: nǐ bù yīng gāi zài xué xiào dà lóu lǐ bēn pǎo.
english: You must not run in the school buildings.

chinese: 我听过这首歌的法语版。
pinyin: wǒ tīng guo zhè shǒu gē de fǎ yǔ bǎn.
english: I heard the song sung in French.

chinese: 你乘飞机还是乘火车去？
pinyin: nǐ chéng fēi jī hái shì chéng huǒ chē qù?
english: Are you going by air or by train?

chinese: 太空旅行已不再是幻想。
pinyin: tài kōng lǚ xíng yǐ bù zài shì huàn xiǎng.
english: Space travel is no longer a dream.

chinese: 你什么时候学会游泳的？
pinyin: nǐ shén me shí hou xué huì yóu yǒng de?
english: When did you learn to swim?

pinyin: méi yǒu shén me là xià de ba?
english: Do you have everything?

chinese: 我記不得哪把球拍是我的了。
pinyin: wǒ jì bù de nǎ bǎ qiú pāi shì wǒ de le.
english: I can't remember which is my racket.

chinese: 我期望能在圣诞节见到你。
pinyin: wǒ qī wàng néng zài shèng dàn jié jiàn dào nǐ.
english: I hope I can see you at Christmas.

pinyin: wǒ de chē zuó wǎn bèi tōu le.
english: My car was stolen last night.

chinese: 他喜欢我！—厨师的母鸡说。
pinyin: tā xǐ huan wǒ! chú shī de mǔ jī shuō.
english: He likes me! - The cook's hen said.

chinese: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
pinyin: wǒ men de yǎn jing xū yào shí jiān lái shì yìng hēi àn.
english: Our eyes take time to adjust to the dark.

chinese: 我要一個解釋，而且現在就要！
pinyin: wǒ yào yī gè jiě shì, ér qiě xiàn zài jiù yào!
english: I want an explanation and I want it now.

pinyin: nǐ bù xǐ huan bàng qiú ma?
english: Don't you like baseball?

pinyin: wǒ huì bāng nǐ táo pǎo de.
english: I'll help you escape.

pinyin: wǒ děng le bù zhǐ sān xiǎo shí.
english: I waited more than three hours.

chinese: 人的行爲不總是理性的。
pinyin: rén de xíng wéi bù zǒng shì lǐ xìng de.
english: People don't always behave rationally.

pinyin: bié duì tā yǒu tài gāo de qī wàng.
english: Don't expect too much of him.

pinyin: wǒ shuō guo le, bì zuǐ!
english: I said shut up!

pinyin: shuō shí huà, wǒ bìng bù xǐ huan nǐ.
english: To be honest, I don't like you at all.

chinese: 演出真的很有意思，你该去看看的。
pinyin: yǎn chū zhēn de hěn yǒu yì si, nǐ gāi qù kàn kan de.
english: The show was very interesting. You should have seen it.

chinese: 你知道为什么他今天逃课了吗？
pinyin: nǐ zhī dào wèi shén me tā jīn tiān táo kè le ma?
english: Do you know why he skipped class today?

pinyin: nà shi shéi de huán?
english: Whose ring is that?

chinese: 非常感谢你所做的一切。
pinyin: fēi cháng gǎn xiè nǐ suǒ zuò de yī qiè.
english: I'm very grateful for everything you've done for me.

chinese: 她很少去像那样的地方。
pinyin: tā hěn shǎo qù xiàng nà yàng de dì fang.
english: She seldom goes to that sort of place.

chinese: 她的夢想是成為一名護士。
pinyin: tā de mèng xiǎng shì chéng wéi yī míng hù shi.
english: Her dream is to become a nurse.

pinyin: nǐ gāi guò lai de.
english: You should come over.

chinese: 我想要你把真相告诉我。
pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào nǐ bǎ zhēn xiàng gào su wǒ.
english: I want you to tell me the truth.

chinese: 请问，这款你们店里有吗？
pinyin: qǐng wèn, zhè kuǎn nǐ men diàn lǐ yǒu ma?
english: Excuse me, do you have any of these in your store?

pinyin: shàng ge zhōu yī wǒ qù diào yú le.
english: I went fishing last Monday.

chinese: 有人在火车上偷了我的钱包。
pinyin: yǒu rén zài huǒ chē shàng tōu le wǒ de qián bāo.
english: Someone stole my wallet on the train.

chinese: 我好饿，什么时候可以去吃中饭？
pinyin: wǒ hǎo è, shén me shí hou kě yǐ qù chī zhōng fàn?
english: I'm pretty hungry. When can we go have lunch?

pinyin: wǒ zài lìng yī gè dì fang.
english: I was somewhere else.

chinese: 你夏天去了任何地方嗎？
pinyin: nǐ xià tiān qù le rèn hé dì fang ma?
english: Did you go anywhere for the summer?

pinyin: tā shì tōu tōu qù de.
english: She went secretly.

pinyin: duō kuī le nǐ, wǒ hái huó zhe.
english: I owe it you that I am still alive.

pinyin: xiǎng sǐ nǐ lā!
english: I can't tell you how much we've missed you.

pinyin: néng bù néng qǐng nǐ ná zhe zhè duān?
english: Will you please hold this edge?

pinyin: zhè me ě xīn de!
english: How disgusting!

chinese: 我认识史密斯先生有好多年了。
pinyin: wǒ rèn shi shǐ mì sī xiān sheng yǒu hǎo duō nián le.
english: I've known Mr Smith for many years.

pinyin: nǐ diū le bù qiāng ma?
english: Did you lose your rifle?

pinyin: tā hé wǒ yī yàng gāo.
english: He is as tall as I.

chinese: 不要隐瞒你对此的想法。
pinyin: bù yào yǐn mán nǐ duì cǐ de xiǎng fǎ.
english: Don't conceal what you feel about it.

pinyin: wǒ yàn juàn le wǒ de gōng zuò.
english: I am tired of my work.

chinese: 你可以想象在月球上行走吗？
pinyin: nǐ kě yǐ xiǎng xiàng zài yuè qiú shàng xíng zǒu ma?
english: Can you imagine walking on the moon?

chinese: 露西和我一样有很多朋友。
pinyin: lù xī hé wǒ yī yàng yǒu hěn duō péng you.
english: Like me, Lucy has many friends.

pinyin: nǐ zài sā huǎng.
english: You're lying.

pinyin: wǒ hěn qīn pèi tā de cái gàn.
english: I feel admiration for his talent.

pinyin: wǒ méi xiǎng yào dǎ tā.
english: I didn't mean to hit him.

chinese: 我也想要和你身上那件同样的外套。
pinyin: wǒ yě xiǎng yào hé nǐ shēn shang nèi jiàn tóng yàng de wài tào.
english: I want the same jacket as you're wearing.

chinese: 我覺得你的法文大有改善。
pinyin: wǒ jué de nǐ de fǎ wén dà yǒu gǎi shàn.
english: I think your French has gotten much better.

chinese: 你的问题和我没有关系。
pinyin: nǐ de wèn tí hé wǒ méi yǒu guān xi.
english: Your problems don't concern me.

pinyin: nà jiù shì wèn tí suǒ zài le.
english: Therein lies the problem.

chinese: 没有什么和和平一样重要。
pinyin: méi yǒu shén me hé hé píng yī yàng zhòng yào.
english: Nothing's as important as peace.

pinyin: nǐ gěi wǒ fēng le!
english: You drive me nuts!

pinyin: wǒ néng jiè yòng nǐ de jiǎn dāo ma?
english: Can I borrow your scissors?

chinese: 尤其是要注意你吃的和喝的东西。
pinyin: yóu qí shì yào zhù yì nǐ chī de hé hē de dōng xi.
english: You have to pay special attention to what you eat and drink.

pinyin: kě bù kě yǐ hé nǐ shuō jǐ jù?
english: Can I have a few words with you?

chinese: 这支笔和我昨天掉的那支一样。
pinyin: zhè zhī bǐ hé wǒ zuó tiān diào de nèi zhī yī yàng.
english: This is the same pen that I lost yesterday.

pinyin: wǒ xiǎng yào hé nǐ yī qǐ qù
english: I want to go with you.

pinyin: nǐ hé wǒ dōu shì nán rén.
english: Both you and I are men.

pinyin: tā yuán liàng le nán hái de cū lǔ.
english: She forgave the boy for his rudeness.

chinese: 我们同意了第二天一早开始。
pinyin: wǒ men tóng yì le dì èr tiān yī zǎo kāi shǐ.
english: We agreed to start early the next morning.

pinyin: nǐ shì dān shēn ma?
english: Are you single?

chinese: 无论如何，都不关你的事。
pinyin: wú lùn rú hé, dōu bù guān nǐ de shì.
english: In any case, it's none of your business.

pinyin: shì nǐ xīn li yǒu guǐ ba?
english: Do you have a guilty conscience?

chinese: 他英勇的行为带给了他光荣。
pinyin: tā yīng yǒng de xíng wéi dài gěi le tā guāng róng.
english: His acts of courage brought him glory.

chinese: 我该说，他的行为是典范。
pinyin: wǒ gāi shuō, tā de xíng wéi shì diǎn fàn.
english: I must say, his behaviour is exemplary.

chinese: 海滩上你到底愿意去吗？
pinyin: hǎi tān shàng nǐ dào dǐ yuàn yì qù ma?
english: Are you willing to go to the beach?

pinyin: ràng wǒ men bǎo chí lián luò.
english: Let's keep in touch.

pinyin: nǐ yǒu yì wù huán zhài.
english: You're liable for the debt.

pinyin: rì běn yǒu hěn duō huó huǒ shān.
english: There are many active volcanoes in Japan.

pinyin: zhè jiǎo zi shì shén me xiàn de a?
english: What is the filling in these dumplings?

chinese: 魔术师吸引了孩子们的注意。
pinyin: mó shù shī xī yǐn le hái zi men de zhù yì.
english: The magician had the children's attention.

pinyin: méi yǒu shén me shì shén shèng de.
english: Nothing is holy.

chinese: 我相信你很快就能复原。
pinyin: wǒ xiāng xìn nǐ hěn kuài jiù néng fù yuán.
english: I believe you'll get over it soon.

pinyin: nǐ zuó tiān dǎ bàng qiú le méi yǒu?
english: Did you play baseball yesterday?

chinese: 你在哪里找打了这个皮夹？
pinyin: nǐ zài nǎ lǐ zhǎo dǎ le zhè ge pí jiā?
english: Where did you find this wallet?

chinese: 那是我说过的最愚蠢的话了。
pinyin: nà shi wǒ shuō guo de zuì yú chǔn de huà le.
english: That's the stupidest thing I've ever said.

pinyin: shéi dōu zhī dào zhī zú cháng lè.
english: Everybody knows that happiness is in contentment.

chinese: 我和一位朋友住在一起。
pinyin: wǒ hé yī wèi péng you zhù zài yī qǐ.
english: I am staying with a friend.

chinese: 我会尽可能多给你写信的。
pinyin: wǒ huì jǐn kě néng duō gěi nǐ xiě xìn de.
english: I will write letters to you as often as I can.

pinyin: nǐ de zuǐ chún shàng yǒu dōng xi.
english: You've got something on your lip.

chinese: 她的借口我已经听腻了。
pinyin: tā de jiè kǒu wǒ yǐ jīng tīng nì le.
english: I'm sick of her excuses.
